title: Predictable randomness via random.randint (python) — review required
description: The python call random.randint draws from a non-cryptographic generator. Its output is predictable from past values or seed, so tokens, nonces, and temporary secrets built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to secrets.token_bytes / secrets.choice.
remediation: Draw security values from secrets.token_bytes / secrets.choice. Keep the fast generator only for simulations, games, and sampling with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any random.randint call regardless of purpose; no-arg generator forms are separate rules.
